name: RfcWfmWorkbookDiscovery
input: source_family plus configured rfc_wfm_import_directory or explicit manually selected file
automatic_steps: load the exact accepted directory setting; if unset/inaccessible return typed result and do not search elsewhere
enumerate direct directory entries only using platform APIs that expose reparse/symlink/file attributes
reject nonregular files, symbolic links, Windows reparse points and names outside the exact source-family profile

for each family-shaped candidate perform bounded stability probes: size and mtime must remain identical across two probes separated by at least 1000 ms and file must be openable for read without sharing-state indicating an active writer

derive candidate rank: RFC uses stable mtime_ns; WFM extracts the profile timestamp token and uses its raw fixed-width token for deterministic pre-validation ordering then validates the selected token as a real profile-local datetime
sort by family chronology descending and profile tie-break; collision suffix integer never contributes chronology
pass only that candidate to XLSX/security/profile validation; if it fails return failure for that candidate and never fall back automatically to an older candidate
manual_steps: normalize operator-selected local path and prove it names one regular non-reparse .xlsx file
perform the same stability and XLSX security checks
classify/validate the selected workbook as the requested source family using headers/content profile even if its physical filename does not satisfy automatic discovery naming
require WFM supported source chronology; manual selection cannot invent it from mtime

stability.rule: failure to reach stable state produces FILE_UNSTABLE and no parsing/domain mutation

windows_rules: resolved path must remain under the configured directory for automatic discovery after case-insensitive Windows canonical path comparison
manual selection may be outside configured directory but is never added to automatic search scope
UNC/alternate-root/device namespace paths are rejected unless a future accepted profile explicitly supports them
output: one CandidateDescriptor containing family/profile, safe path handle/reference, filename, stable size/mtime, chronology kind/value and discovery provenance; no business entity mutation
